name_zh: 托贝/荷兰/三角洲工程/水利民主/北海防洪/水管理/气候适应
name_en: Toebes/Netherlands/Delta Works/Water Democracy/North Sea Flood/Water Management/Climate Adaptation
description_zh: 约汉·范·托贝 (1903-1989) 荷兰水利工程师，1953年北海大洪水后主导三角洲工程，建立水利民主决策模式，与水共生而非对抗，荷兰成为全球水管理/气候适应标杆，三角洲工程被誉为现代世界七大奇迹之一。
description_en: Johan van Toebes (1903-1989) Dutch hydraulic engineer, led Delta Works after 1953 North Sea Flood, established water democracy decision model, living with water not against it, Netherlands became global water management/climate adaptation benchmark, Delta Works hailed as modern world seven wonders.
reason_zh: 托贝代表低地国家如何通过技术工程与民主决策双重手段实现国家生存，展示了与水共生理念如何超越单纯工程对抗，其水利民主模式为全球沿海城市气候适应提供了治理范式。
reason_en: Toebes represents how lowland nation achieves national survival through technical engineering and democratic decision dual approach, demonstrating how living-with-water philosophy transcends pure engineering confrontation, his water democracy model providing governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.

expected_en: Master how technical engineering combines with democratic decision for national survival, grasp living-with-water philosophy transcending engineering confrontation, evaluate Dutch water democracy model governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.
